title: fix(fields): a readonly password field with no value draws the No-value affordance (objectui#10639)
body:
Fixes #10639
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`PasswordField`'s readonly branch returned the eight-dot mask without reading `value`, so `null`, `undefined` and `''` drew exactly what a set credential draws. The branch now asks the password cell's empty predicate, `isEmptyValue(coerceToSafeValue(value))`, the same call `MaskedCellRenderer` has made since objectui#8678, and draws the shared `EmptyValue` affordance (accessible name "No value") when it answers empty. A present value keeps today's markup byte for byte: a `span` with class `text-sm` holding eight bullets. The value is never printed.

- `isEmptyValue` comes from `@object-ui/core`, `EmptyValue` from `@object-ui/components`, and `coerceToSafeValue` from `packages/fields/src/coerceToSafeValue.ts`, its own module. The widget imports nothing from the fields barrel `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`, which lazy-loads it, so there is no cycle. Measured: zero `index` specifiers in the widget.
- No second copy of the predicate. The widget calls the same two helpers, and the pin's THE RULE test holds the widget and the `password` cell to the same answer on every census input, so a later change to either side goes red.
- The editable branch is unchanged.

## Surface extension, stated

The claim's file surface names the widget, the pins and one changeset. The Features bullet in `content/docs/fields/password.mdx` read "Read-only mode always shows" the mask. This change made that false, and the docs-driven rule in AGENTS.md (Coding Standards, number 2) wants the docs to match the code, so that one bullet now says what read-only mode shows for a stored value and for an empty one. The 17 open pull requests' file lists were read: none touches that file. If the seat rules otherwise, drop that one hunk. Nothing else in the PR depends on it.

## The pin: `PasswordField.readonlyEmpty-10639` (10 tests)

- EMPTY: readonly `null`, `undefined` and `''` draw the affordance with aria-label "No value" and no bullet character. The innerHTML is asserted not to be the mask first, so the defect's absence is checked before the replacement.
- PRESENT: readonly `'hunter2'`, `SECRET_MASK`, `{}` and `'   '` render innerHTML byte-equal to the mask from before this card, with no affordance, and the value's own text never reaches the DOM.
- THE RULE: for 10 inputs (the seven above plus `[]`, `['']` and `['x']`), the widget draws the affordance exactly when the `password` cell does. A lit control checks that the cell really separates the inputs.
- CONTROL: the editable widget renders an `input` of type `password` that carries the value (empty when nothing is stored), plus the reveal toggle, and no affordance.

### Red on the base, green on the fix

On disk the fix marker counted 0, the base branch line counted 1, and the blob equalled the BASE blob. Result: `Tests 4 failed | 6 passed (10)`, exit 1. The four failures are EMPTY x3 and THE RULE. Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PATH`. The restored blob equals the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is 0 bytes.
